name: Sasabonsam
description: A forest-dwelling vampiric being from Akan folklore (Ghana, Côte d'Ivoire, Togo), described as a hairy humanoid with iron teeth and hooked feet who sits in trees and snatches up unwary travellers. Documented ethnographically by R. S. Rattray in the 1920s.
regions: Akan-speaking parts of southeastern Côte d'Ivoire
origin: Akan-speaking regions of southern Ghana and adjoining areas of Togo and Côte d'Ivoire; with diaspora attestations in Akan-influenced Caribbean folklore.
